title: permission-denied-audit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the permission-denied-audit PermissionDenied emitter. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "permission-denied-audit". Evolves additive-only. Privacy-safe: never carries the full command, file path, or tool_input body.

subject.description: Privacy-safe denial subject: "Bash:<first-token>" for Bash (e.g. "Bash:git"), otherwise the tool name only.
